conditions: Customer has at least one product in the cart
Customer proceeds through all checkout steps (cart → address → payment) using cash on delivery
items.expected: Each checkout step advances without a sign-in prompt appearing; the order confirmation page is shown

conditions: Customer is signed in with a profile that has a billing address
Customer navigates to the billing address step of checkout
items.expected: The billing address form is displayed pre-filled; the fields contain the customer's profile address data

conditions: Customer is signed in with a product in the cart
Customer selects cash on delivery as payment method
items.expected: The payment step accepts cash on delivery; the order confirmation page is displayed

conditions: Customer is signed in with a profile that has a saved billing address
Customer navigates to the billing address step of checkout
items.expected: The billing address form is displayed pre-filled; the fields contain the customer's profile address data

conditions: Checkout page is loaded and accessible
Axe-core scans the checkout form with WCAG A and AA rules
items.expected: No axe violations are reported; violations array is empty

excluded.reason: The checkout flow has no browser-observable security behaviour beyond session continuity, which AC-1 covers functionally. No token endpoints, no credential forms, and no account enumeration surfaces are part of this story's scope.
TOOL-21 is about admin product search narrowing — a different UI surface with no overlap with the signed-in customer checkout flow tested by this story.
